_source: point 29 cases (group point29) of w2/gnu/shell_tools.json: w2/gnu shell_tools, recorded 2026-10-21 with scripts/rec.py: xargs, date, uniq, shell arithmetic, point 29 shell details (brief D). One container per image, a fresh /tmp/w per case (not recorded), `docker exec ... sh -c CMD` as uid 0, stdout and stderr apart, locale as in `locale`. Normalised only: date output of the clock (EPOCH, DATE, TIME, DATE_TIME, WEEKDAY MONTH, YEAR, NANOS9, EPOCHNANOS19, YYYYMMDDHHMMSS, DATETTIME+00:00 (the offset kept), DDD, DD Mon YYYY HH:MM:SS +0000) and `date --help` / `uniq --help` cut to their first 3 lines per stream; the PID of bash -i's `cannot set terminal process group (PID)`; times in `history` output (EPOCH, DATE TIME). Docker host linux/arm64, Docker 29.8.2. Fix round 1 of task 3.9 (2026-10-28): image debian_9 (bash 4.4.12, the version of the EdgeOS persona's Debian base) with the two history cases of HISTTIMEFORMAT, same docker exec sh -c form, docker run --rm --network none.
